newsitem.title: INDIA: India authorises 165,000 bales cotton exports.
newsitem.headline: India authorises 165,000 bales cotton exports.

text.p: India on Tuesday authorised the export of a fresh tranche of 165,000 bales of cotton for the 1996/97 (September-August) season, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
PTI said the state-run Cotton Corporation of India was authorised to export 100,000 bales while the Andhra Pradesh Cooperative Marketing Federation was allowed to export 65,000 bales.
The fresh quota was in addition to an earlier authorisation of 1.05 million bales of cotton exports in 1996/97, PTI said.
Government officials could not be reached for comment.
